description: The organization does not determine and document the legal authority to collect, use, maintain, and share PII, or operates outside the documented authority.
applicability: This signal applies to: Cloud Service Providers seeking FedRAMP authorization Federal agencies using cloud services Third-party assessment organizations (3PAOs) Systems processing federal information containing PII

metadata.detection_notes: Detection guidance: Look for missing legal authority documentation, absence of citations to statutory or regulatory authorities, lack of documented permissions for PII collection and processing, no evidence of authority review or validation, and processing activities that exceed documented authorities.
